message: Command `grep -n "SOPC_TypeInternalIndex_SIZE\|SOPC_KnownEncodeableTypes\|SOPC_TypeInternalIndex" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/S2OPC/src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encodeabletype.c | head -40` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The fuzzer uses `buf[0] % SOPC_TypeInternalIndex_SIZE` to index into `SOPC_KnownEncodeableTypes`. The vulnerability is an out-of-bounds access in the builtintype tables. Let me look at `sopc_builtintypes.c` and the encodeable type tables.
